name: 日付と時刻の個別指定欄
prompt:
Create a faithful static image of only the two separate date and time input pills from the source crop. Match the crop geometry and neutral gray surfaces. Use the native Japanese preview for the Japanese field values. Target 212×44 pixels in proportion.

The crop contains exactly two adjacent rounded rectangles on a white background: a left date field about 110px wide, a 4–5px gap, and a right time field about 96px wide. Each field is about 36px tall, vertically centered with roughly 3–4px top and bottom padding. Use soft rounded corners around 10px and a uniform light neutral-gray fill matching the source, not the preview’s mint green.

Center 「2026年6月4日」 in the left field in dark near-black regular text. The original source shows “4 Jun 2024,” but the native Japanese preview supplies the localized date value and year: 「2026年6月4日」. Center 「12:00」 in the right field in blue (#3478F2), following the source’s blue “12:00 PM” and the user’s instruction that this link-like time text must be blue. Keep only the time value blue; the date stays dark.

Do not add the description label 「解除する日時」 because it is outside the assigned source crop. No app frame, header, footer, picker wheel, icons, extra labels, or shadows. Static image only.
reviewNotes: Localized date remains dark and 12:00 is blue per user request. Source crop ratio is 4.82:1; candidate has excess white margin, wrong 3:1 canvas and undersized fields. Keep needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
